id.description: The globally unique generated id for the session.

sessionStoreId.description:
The id of the {@link GenaiCore.SessionStore} instance that is the
parent for this session.

meta.description:
Contains metadata about object creation and update times. This field is intended to help
implementations of {@link GenaiCore.SessionStore.RetentionPolicy}.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

state.description:
Serialized object representing the latest state associated with the session. If the session state is too large
for cassandra, we persist it in #stateFile instead. Only one of `state` or #stateFile should be set.

stateFile.description:
If the session state is too large for cassandra, we persist it in this file instead. Only one of
#state or `stateFile` should be set.

title: Concrete session instance and corresponding state used for {@link GenaiCore.SessionStore.Kv}.
name: GenaiCore.Session.Kv
